title: ProofCoder: Continuous Reasoning for Automated Software Verification
abstract: arXiv:2611.14106v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Formal verification using proof assistants provides strong correctness guarantees for software, but constructing proofs remains labor-intensive and requires significant expertise. Recent approaches based on large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating proof synthesis. However, these approaches typically constrain the model to a rigid tactic-generation loop, in which the surrounding system controls premise retrieval, proof-state management, and backtracking. We introduce ProofCoder, an agentic proof-synthesis system for Rocq that approaches theorem proving from a coding-agent perspective. Rather than generating tactics within a fixed loop, ProofCoder reasons continuously throughout proof search and uses proof-assistant feedback to decide when to gather additional information, inspect proof states, revise previously generated proof fragments, or backtrack to an earlier point in the proof. translated_title: ProofCoder：面向自动化软件验证的连续推理
translated_abstract: 使用证明助手进行形式化验证能够为软件提供强有力的正确性保证，但构造证明仍然是一项劳动密集型工作，且需要大量的专业知识。近期基于大语言模型（LLM）的方法在自动化证明合成方面展现出了潜力。然而，这些方法通常将模型限制在僵化的策略生成循环中，由外围系统控制前提检索、证明状态管理和回溯。我们提出了ProofCoder，这是一个面向Rocq的智能体式证明合成系统，它从编码智能体的视角来处理定理证明问题。ProofCoder并非在固定循环中生成策略，而是在整个证明搜索过程中持续进行推理，并利用证明助手的反馈来决定何时收集额外信息、检查证明状态、修改先前生成的证明片段，或回溯到证明中较早的位置。这使其能够迭代地协同……
tldr: ProofCoder从编码智能体视角出发，让模型在整个证明搜索过程中持续推理，并根据证明助手的反馈自主决定信息收集、证明状态检查、片段修改和回溯，突破了传统LLM方法僵化策略生成循环的限制，实现了面向Rocq的自动化证明合成。
en_tdlr: ProofCoder approaches Rocq theorem proving from a coding-agent perspective, enabling the model to reason continuously throughout proof search and use proof-assistant feedback to autonomously decide when to gather information, inspect proof states, revise proof fragments, or backtrack, thereby overcoming the rigid tactic-generation loops of prior LLM-based approaches.
